test_cases.title: Document classified into one category with valid confidence range
test_cases.test_inputs: A well‑formed text document belonging to category "Finance".

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns a response containing exactly one category identifier and a confidence score between 0 and 1.

steps.action: Verify that the returned category is one of the 12 defined categories.
steps.expected: The category identifier matches one of the allowed category codes.

steps.action: Verify that the confidence score is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1.
steps.expected: The confidence value satisfies 0 ≤ score ≤ 1.

test_cases.title: Boundary confidence values 0 and 1 are accepted
test_cases.test_inputs: Two documents engineered to produce confidence scores of exactly 0 and exactly 1.
test_cases.assumptions: The classification model can be forced (e.g., via test hooks) to output the specified confidence values.

steps.action: Submit the document that should yield a confidence score of 0.
steps.expected: The service returns a valid category and a confidence score of 0.

steps.action: Submit the document that should yield a confidence score of 1.
steps.expected: The service returns a valid category and a confidence score of 1.

test_cases.title: Document with confidence below 0.60 is routed to human review
test_cases.test_inputs: A document that causes the classifier to return a confidence of 0.45.

steps.action: Submit the low‑confidence document to the service.
steps.expected: The response indicates that the document is placed in the human review queue and no automatic category is returned.

test_cases.title: Boundary confidence exactly 0.60 is classified automatically
test_cases.test_inputs: A document that causes the classifier to return a confidence of 0.60.

steps.action: Submit the document with confidence 0.60.
steps.expected: The service returns an automatic classification (category and confidence) and does not route the document to human review.

test_cases.title: Three most influential passages are returned for a classification
test_cases.test_inputs: A document with clear content that yields a confidence of 0.85.

steps.action: Submit the document to the classification service.
steps.expected: The response includes the selected category, confidence score, and a list of text passages.

steps.action: Count the number of passages returned in the list.
steps.expected: Exactly three passages are provided.

steps.action: Verify that each returned passage is a substring of the original document.
steps.expected: All three passages exist in the original document text.

test_cases.title: Error handling for unsupported document format
test_cases.test_inputs: A binary file (e.g., an image) instead of a text document.

steps.action: Submit the unsupported file to the classification service.
steps.expected: The service returns an error response indicating invalid input format and does not produce a classification, confidence score, or passages.

test_cases.title: Macro‑averaged F1 score meets minimum requirement
test_cases.preconditions: The classification model has been trained and a held‑out evaluation set is available.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation script correctly computes macro‑averaged F1 according to the specification.

steps.action: Run the model on the held‑out evaluation set and compute the macro‑averaged F1 score.
steps.expected: The computed macro‑averaged F1 score is reported.

steps.action: Compare the reported score with the threshold 0.90.
steps.expected: The score is greater than or equal to 0.90.

test_cases.title: Macro‑averaged F1 score at the boundary value
test_cases.preconditions: The model has been tuned to produce a macro‑averaged F1 score close to 0.90.
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation set is representative and the scoring algorithm is deterministic.

steps.action: Execute the evaluation and obtain the macro‑averaged F1 score.
steps.expected: The reported score is exactly 0.90.

steps.action: Verify that the requirement is considered satisfied.
steps.expected: The system marks the requirement as met because the score meets the minimum.

test_cases.title: Recall difference between Turkish and English documents within allowed limit
test_cases.preconditions: The model has been evaluated separately on Turkish‑language and English‑language subsets of the held‑out set.
test_cases.assumptions: Recall is computed per language subset using the same definition.

steps.action: Calculate recall for Turkish documents.
steps.expected: Recall_Tur is reported.

steps.action: Calculate recall for English documents.
steps.expected: Recall_Eng is reported.

steps.action: Compute the absolute difference |Recall_Tur – Recall_Eng|.
steps.expected: The difference is less than or equal to 5 percentage points.

test_cases.title: Recall difference exceeds allowed limit (error case)
test_cases.preconditions: A model version that performs significantly better on one language than the other is deployed.
test_cases.assumptions: Recall values are obtained from the same evaluation run.

steps.action: Measure recall for Turkish documents.
steps.expected: Recall_Tur is reported.

steps.action: Measure recall for English documents.
steps.expected: Recall_Eng is reported.

steps.action: Calculate the absolute difference |Recall_Tur – Recall_Eng|.
steps.expected: The difference is greater than 5 percentage points, causing the requirement to be violated.

test_cases.title: Macro-averaged F1 score meets minimum threshold
test_cases.assumptions: The held-out evaluation set is representative and contains labeled documents for all target classes.

steps.action: Run the classification model on the held-out evaluation set and collect predicted labels.
steps.expected: Predictions are produced for every document in the set.

steps.action: Calculate the macro-averaged F1 score from the predictions and the ground‑truth labels.
steps.expected: The computed macro‑averaged F1 score is reported.

steps.action: Compare the reported macro‑averaged F1 score with the required minimum of 0.90.
steps.expected: The score is greater than or equal to 0.90, satisfying the requirement.

test_cases.title: Macro-averaged F1 score below required threshold
test_cases.assumptions: The same evaluation set and model version as in TC-1 are used.

steps.action: Intentionally degrade the model (e.g., disable a feature) and run it on the held-out evaluation set.
steps.expected: Predictions are produced for every document.

steps.action: Calculate the macro‑averaged F1 score from these degraded predictions.
steps.expected: The computed macro‑averaged F1 score is reported.

steps.action: Check whether the score is lower than 0.90.
steps.expected: The score is below 0.90, indicating a failure of the requirement.

test_cases.title: Recall difference between Turkish and English documents within allowed range
test_cases.assumptions: The evaluation set contains a sufficient number of Turkish and English documents with ground‑truth labels for each class.

steps.action: Run the classification model on the evaluation set and record recall for each class separately for Turkish documents.
steps.expected: Recall values for Turkish documents are obtained.

steps.action: Run the model on the same set and record recall for each class separately for English documents.
steps.expected: Recall values for English documents are obtained.

steps.action: Compute the absolute difference in recall between Turkish and English for each class and determine the maximum difference.
steps.expected: The maximum recall difference is calculated.

steps.action: Verify that the maximum difference does not exceed 5 percentage points.
steps.expected: The difference is ≤ 5 %, satisfying the requirement.

test_cases.title: Recall difference between Turkish and English documents exceeds allowed range
test_cases.assumptions: A version of the model with a known bias toward English documents is available.

steps.action: Run the biased model on the evaluation set and record recall for Turkish documents.
steps.expected: Recall values for Turkish documents are obtained.

steps.action: Run the same model on the evaluation set and record recall for English documents.
steps.expected: Recall values for English documents are obtained.

steps.action: Calculate the absolute recall difference for each class and find the maximum difference.
steps.expected: The maximum recall difference is calculated.

steps.action: Check whether the maximum difference exceeds 5 percentage points.
steps.expected: The difference is greater than 5 %, indicating a violation of the requirement.

test_cases.title: Configuration change takes effect without restart and without dropping in‑flight requests
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway is running, no pending restart, at least one client request is in‑flight.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid configuration change (e.g., enable request timeout logging).

steps.action: Send a long‑running request to the gateway (e.g., a large file download).
steps.expected: Request is accepted and processing starts.

steps.action: Apply the valid configuration change via the management API.
steps.expected: Gateway acknowledges the change immediately; no restart is triggered.

steps.action: Observe the in‑flight request until completion.
steps.expected: The request completes successfully; no error or dropped connection occurs.

steps.action: Send a new request after the change.
steps.expected: The new request is processed according to the updated configuration.

test_cases.title: Invalid configuration change is rejected without affecting in‑flight requests
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway is running and processing a normal request.
test_cases.test_inputs: Invalid configuration payload (e.g., syntax error or unsupported parameter).

steps.action: Start a normal request to the gateway.
steps.expected: Request is accepted.

steps.action: Submit the invalid configuration change via the management API.
steps.expected: Gateway returns an error response indicating the configuration is invalid; no restart occurs.

steps.action: Verify the in‑flight request continues processing.
steps.expected: The request completes successfully, unchanged by the rejected configuration.

test_cases.title: Simultaneous configuration changes are applied atomically without dropping requests
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway is idle (no active requests).
test_cases.test_inputs: Two valid configuration changes sent concurrently.

steps.action: Send two configuration change requests at the same time via the management API.
steps.expected: Both changes are accepted; the gateway applies them sequentially without requiring a restart.

steps.action: Immediately send a new request to the gateway.
steps.expected: The request is processed using the combined effect of both configuration changes.

test_cases.title: Logging of required fields for each request
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway logging is enabled and configured to write logs to a readable file.
test_cases.test_inputs: A standard HTTP GET request from client ID "client-123" to endpoint "/api/status".

steps.action: Send the HTTP GET request to the gateway.
steps.expected: Gateway returns a 200 response within a measurable duration.

steps.action: Read the latest log entry generated by the gateway.
steps.expected: Log entry contains: a unique tracking ID, client ID = 'client-123', endpoint = '/api/status', response code = 200, and the request duration.

test_cases.title: Logging persists when request processing time is near timeout boundary
test_cases.preconditions: Gateway timeout is configured to 5 seconds.
test_cases.test_inputs: A request that takes exactly 5 seconds to process.

steps.action: Send a request that deliberately delays response for 5 seconds.
steps.expected: Gateway returns a successful response (or timeout response) after ~5 seconds.

steps.action: Inspect the corresponding log entry.
steps.expected: Log entry includes the correct duration (~5 s) and all required fields (tracking ID, client ID, endpoint, response code).

test_cases.title: Missing logging configuration results in no log entry for a request

steps.action: Check the log file for an entry corresponding to the request.

test_cases.title: Maksimum dosya sayısı ve boyut sınırının sınırda testi

test_cases.title: Dosya türü ve boyut limitinin aşılması durumunda hata mesajı

steps.expected: Sistem, dosyanın maksimum 10 MB limitini aştığını belirten bir hata mesajı gösterir ve dosyayı yüklemez.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, 1 adet GIF dosyası (5 MB) seçer.

test_cases.title: Taslak başvurunun 30 gün sonunda erişilebilirliği sınırı

steps.expected: Sistem, taslak bulunamadı hatası verir; kullanıcı yeni bir başvuru başlatmak zorundadır.
